name: Taalk

sources.title: Submit your Startup — Free vs INR 1999 Growth vs INR 4499 Elite plans

conditions: Free plan publishes 'only selected posts' — no guaranteed publication
Free tier is a brand mention only: no do-follow link and no standard publishing time (runs on the editorial schedule)
Guaranteed feature with a do-follow link and 3-5 day publishing requires the Growth plan at INR 1,999 (list INR 3,999); Elite is INR 4,499 (list INR 9,999)
requirements: Startup/business suitable for an entrepreneur-focused video magazine and startup-features site
Free submissions go through https://taalk.com/free-submmission/ (sic — misspelled slug on their own link)
preparation: Startup name, URL, description, founder details, logo/images
Decide between free (brand mention, maybe) vs paid Growth (guaranteed feature + dofollow) vs Elite (SEO optimization + video podcast + newsletter highlight)
Payment via Razorpay pages for paid plans
workflow: Pick a plan: 'Submit now' → /free-submmission/ for the free lane, or 'Pay & Submit' → Razorpay payment pages for Growth/Elite
Fill the submission form and (for paid) complete Razorpay checkout
Editorial team reviews; paid Growth publishes within 3-5 days, free runs on the editorial schedule if selected
watchFor: The free tier will not give you a link at all — brand mention only, and only if your post is selected
Pricing is in INR via Razorpay — expect Indian-payment checkout flows
The free-submission URL slug is literally misspelled 'free-submmission' on their site
Elite bundles a video podcast — clarify deliverables before paying INR 4,499
countsAsLive: A feature post about the startup is published on taalk.com under /startups/ or the Featured Startups category
unknowns: Exact editorial criteria and the free form's fields
